b2.ryoka_finds_tactician_loophole.summary: Ryoka works out that [Tacticians] can only level off chess because no dedicated 'Gamer' class exists yet - a gap in the leveling system itself.

b2.yvlon_wakes_blames_herself.summary: Yvlon wakes from her coma and blames herself for her squad's death to Skinner. Ceria visits her at the Guild and comes back to the inn shaken.

canon_ref.note: Ceria's severed hand moves and casts on its own, kept alive by magic-conductive half-Elf bone.

b2.ryoka_starts_learning_magic_from_ceri.summary: Ryoka starts taking magic lessons from Ceria, who shows off her severed hand - still alive and spell-casting through magic-conductive half-Elf bone.

b2.frost_fairy_swarm_torments_ceria.summary: Dozens of Frost Faeries invade the inn uninvited and torment Ceria with slurs about her missing hand; Ryoka punches one out of the air and gets chased outside by the swarm.

b2.klbkch_tries_forcing_chess_on_workers.summary: Klbkch brings Antinium Workers to force-learn chess, hoping to copy Pawn's spark of individuality. Erin tells him coercion won't work that way, and he seems to genuinely take it in.

b2.thief_caught_stealing_in_liscor.news: A young Human woman was caught stealing from a Gnoll stall in Liscor at night and burned it to the ground with a desperate ring-cast fireball before the Watch took her.

canon_ref.note: Unnamed here; identified as Lyonette once Erin takes her in (2.25). Her low-magic desperation and noble bearing are both on the page.

b2.thief_caught_stealing_in_liscor.summary: A magic-starved noblewoman, later known as Lyonette, is caught stealing food and gear from Krshia's market stall late at night; cornered, she burns the stall down with a ring-cast fireball before the Watch takes her.
